title: Front Garden - Shelly Beach Units
beforeAlt: Wild plants growing with no personality or order, prone to weeds.
afterAlt: A native coastal planting that thrives in harsh salty winds and hot days of the summer sun.
description: These front garden beds were a true challenge. From the removal of nasty weeds such as Asparagus Fern to the actual planting itself, ripping through stubborn Pandanus roots, these garden beds prove to be resilient and worth the push. The aim was to recreate two areas where native grasses could flow with the winds, and small, delicate flowers could still make this garden colourful and pleasant to the eye. These garden beds feature the unique Australian native ground-cover Casuarina glauca 'Cousin It', cascading over the retaining walls and rocks.
